briefing: Markets drifted slightly lower today (NASDAQ -0.8%, S&P 500 -0.3%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy, and letting existing positions ride through this neutral session.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Cash discipline means resisting the urge to invest just because you have money sitting idle. On neutral days without strong bullish signals, it's often better to wait for a clearer opportunity than to force a trade that doesn't meet your criteria.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 現金紀律是指不因為手頭有閒置資金就急於投資。在市場方向不明、缺乏強烈買入訊號的日子裡，耐心等待更明確的機會，往往勝過勉強進行不符合條件的交易。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices slipped modestly today, with the NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500, suggesting a mild pullback in growth and tech-heavy names rather than a broad market selloff. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move, consistent with a low-conviction, directionless trading session. Absent a specific news trigger, this looks like routine profit-taking or consolidation after recent gains.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數均小幅下滑，納斯達克跌幅大於標普500，反映科技股及成長股略為疲弱，而非全面性拋售。市場並無明確的單一觸發因素，屬於較低信心、方向不明的交易日，較可能是近期漲勢後的獲利了結或整理階段。
